subject: small owl on bamboo joint
art_direction: 小猫头鹰立在短竹枝上，圆身墨面和细竹叶形成疏密对照。
visible_description: 小猫头鹰立在短竹枝上，圆身墨面和细竹叶形成疏密对照。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Paint a compact owl perched on one horizontal bamboo joint. Use broad gray ink masses for its round body and a few dry marks for folded wings, keeping the facial discs modest rather than exaggerated. Tilt the head slightly as if listening. Two sparse bamboo leaves rise at one side in diluted green, balancing the dark bird against warm ivory paper. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
